summary.goal: Allow publishing approved plans for orchestrator consumption
summary.context: Publish releases the plan for execution. Produces a plan_ref that orchestrator fetches. UI shows 'Ready for execution' badge on published plans.

acceptance_criteria.description: Publish button visible on approved plans
Publish shows confirmation with orchestrator context
After publish, plan status changes to 'published'
Published plans show 'Ready for execution' badge
Published plans link to execution view (if available)

steps.title: Add Publish button to plan toolbar
steps.description: Publish button visible on approved plans. Indicates next step after approval.

steps.title: Create publish confirmation dialog
steps.description: Dialog explaining what publishing means - plan available to orchestrator for execution.

steps.title: Call publish API endpoint
steps.description: Submit publish to API, receive plan_ref in response.

steps.title: Display plan_ref in UI
steps.description: Show plan_ref for orchestrator integration. Copyable format.

steps.title: Show 'Ready for execution' badge
steps.description: Published plans show prominent badge indicating ready for orchestrator.

acceptance_criteria.description: Shows in plan list and detail

steps.title: Add execution status link placeholder
steps.description: Link to execution view if orchestrator provides status endpoint.
